observations: Blue painted cast-body gear reducer unit, cylindrical housing with ribbed cooling fins
Yellow output shaft protruding from one end, no nameplate or rating plate visible in any photo
Mounted on a flat footed base plate with four bolt holes for floor mounting
Input-side flange visible in photo 0 and photo 1, large circular flange with bolt holes
Paint looks fresh/uniform, no scratches, rust or wear visible on the painted surfaces
No manufacturer logo, model number, serial number or HP rating stamped or plated anywhere visible
Watermark 'IFABROS INDUSTRAL POSTED ON JIJI' is the seller's own listing watermark, not a manufacturer mark

identity.kind: gear reducer / speed reducer, cast iron body

claims.evidence: No nameplate, rating tag, or stamped HP figure visible in photo 0, 1, or 2; claim is seller's text only.
Housing surface texture and ribbed casting pattern visible in photo 0, 1, and 2 is consistent with cast iron/aluminum gear reducer casing.

risks.risk: Actual horsepower/torque rating unverified, affects correct price tier
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the stamped nameplate or rating tag on the housing
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest end of the claimed 15-20hp range as unverified capacity

risks.risk: Internal gear/bearing condition and whether unit is new or reconditioned (fresh paint can mask a refurbished used unit)
risks.proof: Video of shaft being hand-turned or unit running under load, plus close-up of any wear on gear teeth or bearing races

risks.risk: Gear ratio and output speed not stated or shown, needed to size the reducer correctly
risks.proof: Photo of ratio plate or technical spec sheet
risks.if_unproven: priced as unspecified/generic ratio, lower confidence

risks.risk: Output shaft diameter and keyway dimensions not given
risks.proof: Close-up measurement photo or shaft diameter with a tape/caliper in frame
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified fitment, buyer risk of incompatibility

risks.risk: Possible oil seal leakage or missing oil fill, common issue in used reducers, not visible from exterior shots
risks.proof: Photo of oil sight glass/level plug and area beneath unit for leak stains
risks.if_unproven: priced as if seals unconfirmed, same as used not working

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the manufacturer's nameplate/rating tag showing brand, model, ratio, and HP
Short video of the shaft turning freely by hand or unit running under a motor
Photo of the oil fill/level plug area and underside for leak stains
Close-up of output shaft with a measuring tape for diameter and keyway size
response.reason: Item is clearly identifiable by type as a cast-body gear reducer from the photos, but no nameplate, model, or rating is visible so the HP, ratio and working condition claims are unverifiable; price it at worst case (lowest claimed capacity, unconfirmed working condition) until the seller provides the nameplate and a running/turning proof.
